0:
initContainers:
  - name: dind
    image: docker:29-dind
    securityContext:
      privileged: true
    restartPolicy: Always
    env:
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR
        value: /certs
    resources:
      requests:
        memory: 1Gi
      limits:
        memory: 8Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-storage
        mountPath: /var/lib/docker
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
    startupProbe:
      exec:
        command:
          - sh
          - -c
          - docker --tlsverify --tlscacert=/certs/client/ca.pem --tlscert=/certs/client/cert.pem --tlskey=/certs/client/key.pem -H tcp://localhost:2376 info
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
      periodSeconds: 1
      failureThreshold: 30
containers:
  - env:
      - name: DEBIAN_FRONTEND
        value: noninteractive
      - name: DOCKER_HOST
        value: tcp://localhost:2376
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY
        value: "1"
      - name: DOCKER_CERT_PATH
        value: /certs/client
      - name: FORGEJO_RUNNER_K8S_LOG_JOB_OUTPUT
        value: true
    image: ghcr.io/bjw-s-labs/forgejo-runner:ubuntu-24.04
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    resources:
      requests:
        memory: 1Gi
      limits:
        memory: 4Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
        readOnly: true
volumes:
  - name: docker-storage
    ephemeral:
      volumeClaimTemplate:
        metadata:
          labels:
             app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: forgejo-runner-codeberg
        spec:
          storageClassName: local-hostpath
          accessModes:
            - ReadWriteOnce
          resources:
            requests:
              storage: 5Gi
  - name: docker-certs
    emptyDir: {}
restartPolicy: Never
